Name: VirtualKeyboard
Author: zszs1452
Description:
Stardew Valley mod that add simple virtual keyboard

[size=5]Install
[/size]
[size=4]PC User[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Android User[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://github.com/NRTnarathip/SMAPILoader]SMAPILoader[/url].
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Unzip it into Android\data\abc.smapi.gameloader\files\Mods or Use SMAPILauncher -> Mod Manager -> install Mod and select mod zip
[*]SMAPILauncher -> Start Game
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]

[b][b][warn] If you're upgrading from an older version, please delete the old config.json file first.[/b][/b]

A simple virtual keyboard that supports multiple keys and shows on screen.

Press the toggle button on screen to show the keyboard; press it again to hide it.

The config.json file is automatically generated after the first run with the mod.

[size=4][b]Add Button(Android Only)[/b][/size]

To add a new button:

[list=1]
[*]Click the [b]Add[/b] button.
[*]Enter the new button's [b]Enum Key[/b] and [b]description[/b]. (All valid Enum Keys can be found in the [url=https://docs.monogame.net/api/Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Input.Keys.html]official MonoGame documentation[/url]﻿.)
[*]The new custom button will then appear next to the [b]Add[/b] button.
[/list]﻿﻿

[size=4][b]Move Button[/b][/size]

﻿To move a button:
﻿
[list=1]
[*]Click the [b]Edit[/b] button to enter edit mode. A small [b]×[/b](cross) icon will appear in the top-right corner of each button.
[*]Click and hold the button you wish to move, then [b]drag[/b] it to the desired position.
[/list]

[b][size=4]﻿Delete Button[/size][/b]
﻿
To delete a button:

[list=1]
[*]Click the [b]Edit[/b] button to enter edit mode. A small [b]×[/b](cross) icon will appear in the top-right corner of each button.
[*]Simply click the [b]×[/b] icon on the button you wish to remove.

[size=4][b]Resize Button[/b][/size]

To resize buttons:

[list=1]
[*]Open the [i]config.json[/i] file.
[*]Locate and modify the value of the [i]ButtonScale[/i] setting. The default value is 1.0.
[/list][code]  "ButtonScale": 1.0
[/code]
[b][size=4]Set Display Layer[/size][/b]

To set button display layer (above or below game UI):

[list=1]
[*]Open the [i]config.json[/i] file.
[*]Locate and modify the value of the [i]AboveMenu[/i] setting:
[list]
[*][b]0:[/b] Game UI will cover the buttons. (Default)
[*][b]1:[/b] Buttons will be displayed on top of the game UI.
[/list]
[/list][code]﻿﻿  "AboveMenu": 0
[/code]
[b][size=4]Change Toggle Image[/size][/b]

To change the toggle button image:

[list=1]
[*]Add your own image file to the [i]assets [/i]directory.
[*]Open the [i]config.json[/i] file. 
[*]Locate and modify the value of the [i]TogglePath [/i]setting. Set it to the path of your new image file (e.g., [i]"assets/your_image.png"[/i]). The default value is [i]"assets/togglebutton.png"[/i].
[/list][code]  ﻿﻿"TriggerPath": "assets/togglebutton.png"
[/code]
